title: EV Road Trips Suck Now (Except in a Tesla)
summary: Aging Wheels compares a road trip in a Polestar 2 with an identical drive in a Tesla, showing the charging problems of non-Tesla EVs. It argues that outside Tesla's network, EV road trips have become frustrating.
why: HN cites it as a clear side-by-side showing the papercuts of non-Tesla fast charging in EV debates.

quote.text: Aging Wheels did an excellent video[1] on how frustrating the experience can be.
